reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness web dashboard centered on balance, token-usage statistics, channel comparison, usage logs, and activity heatmap visualization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可自定义的余额、令牌用量、渠道对比、使用日志和活动热力图面板。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness web users with a customizable dashboard for balances, token usage, channel comparisons, usage logs, and activity heatmaps.

capabilities: Displays a persistent customizable usage and balance dashboard in the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Reads local aggregated usage data and Claude Code log data for token statistics
Queries configured provider balance endpoints over HTTPS
Exposes loopback-only GET endpoints for provider and usage data
Stores interface preferences and aggregated usage caches locally
